main.description: Resolve one AT-URI record into the data needed to render an enhanced external embed. The records are validated against the requested `url` before any view is built. When validation passes, returns `data`, `associatedRefs` (strongRefs to embed into a post's external.associatedRefs) and the raw `associatedRecords`, plus a legacy `view` for Standard.site records only. When validation fails, only `unverifiedAssociatedRefs` and `unverifiedAssociatedRecords` are returned and no view or data is built. The response is empty (`{}`) when no record URI was usable or the record could not be resolved; clients should fall back to their own link-card rendering in that case and skip writing strongRefs to the post.

A single record is selected from it: the first site.standard.document URI, otherwise the first site.standard.publication URI. Other entries are ignored; a document's publication is discovered from the document itself.

view.description: Legacy hydrated view of the embed, returned for Standard.site records only. Present only when validation passed and the records supply enough information to populate the required `viewExternal` fields.

associatedRefs.description: StrongRefs (URI+CID) of the Atmosphere records selected for persistence in a post, suitable for embedding into its external.associatedRefs: the canonical record, plus only the additional records the service chooses to persist for its collection. This can be a subset of the records used to render `data`, which may also draw on other hydrated records such as recommendations, subscriptions, or favorites. Present only when validation passed. Index-aligned with `associatedRecords`.

items.description: The AT-URI of the verification record to revoke.

revokeReason.description: Reason for revoking the verification. This is optional and can be omitted if not needed.

revokedVerifications.description: List of verification uris successfully revoked

failedRevocations.description: List of verification uris that couldn't be revoked, including failure reasons

uri.description: The AT-URI of the verification record that failed to revoke.

error.description: Description of the error that occurred during revocation.
